verdict.rationale: Morph is a usage-billed LLM API platform, so spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a spend limit, budget threshold, or billing alert. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: token billing with rate limits, half-price standby tier, free prefix caching, and a 'stuck-in-a-loop' classifier. None of these caps or alerts on spend.
